steps.action: On the existing F-host only, run docs/chatgpt_status/topography/shards/height_difference_2/automation/030_apply_attempt_020_existing_f_runner_recovery.ps1; preserve or start exactly one persistent canonical daemon.
Verify all four recovery/output receipts, persistent_daemon_count_after=1, fresh heartbeat, and exact task/attempt/continuation claim before canonical numeric work.
Query official EA LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Extents in native EPSG:27700 at each candidate BNG point; record only exact returned filename/os_ref/sd_flown/ed_flown/transform/geoid/year/latest fields.
Resolve National LIDAR Programme lineage for TQ3595, TQ5090 and TQ2570 from official catalogue features; do not infer survey identity from tile name alone.
Use the persistent EA Composite DTM 1m WCS 2.0.1 route with an XML-capable client; record the real CoverageId through GetCapabilities/DescribeCoverage before any GetCoverage request.
Download actual EA DTM1m raster bytes covering each native HMLR polygon, exclude NoData, and compute min/q1/median/q3/max only from real pixels inside the polygon.
Download OS Terrain 50 without registration, require real archive bytes and TQ39/TQ59/TQ27 members; read each Metadata_<tile>.xml before sampling.
Use documented 50m pixel centres for Terrain50 secondary samples, confirm EPSG:27700 and EPSG:5701 or actual tile datum, and retain earliest/latest flying dates.
Run three EA-primary versus Terrain50-secondary numeric crosschecks and port 8012 readback. Do not convert product/survey RMSE to parcel-specific confidence.
